newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom, ITJ to merge - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom, ITJ to merge - paper.

text.p: Japanese telecommunications firms Japan Telecom Co Ltd and International Telecom Japan Inc (ITJ) plan to merge later this year to compete against the giant carrier Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT), the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday.
The terms of the merger were not yet set, but was likely to be a stock-for-stock merger of about five ITJ stocks for one Japan Telecom share, the newspaper said.
Officials from both companies were not available for comment on the report.

The Nihon Keizai said that, once the merger is completed, Japan's other large carrier, Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd, may strike an alliance with the two companies after further deregulation takes place in the telecoms industry.
There are currently limitations on outside investment in NTT and KDD, but the Nihon Keizai said these regulations are likely to be scrapped by 1999, when NTT is expected to complete its breakup.
